brief:
The Quincy Institute released material characterizing Israel's lobby as wielding disproportionate influence over American foreign policy in ways that conflict with US national interests, according to the think tank's framing. The institute presented the analysis as an examination of how the lobbying apparatus operates and affects American decision-making on matters related to the Middle East and Israel.

The Quincy Institute's characterization suggests the lobby's influence extends beyond typical advocacy channels and into the core machinery of foreign policy formation. The think tank framed its analysis as addressing what it described as a threat to American democratic autonomy, though the material provided did not detail specific mechanisms, recent legislative votes, or particular policy examples illustrating the lobby's operational tactics or concrete outcomes.
dek: An unflinching exposé of Israel's Lobby, showing how its outsized influence works against our national interests and threatens our freedom.
title: Israel lobby exerts outsized influence over US policy, Quincy Institute argues.
